## What changed

One change, aimed at how much context an agent burns reading your `lat.md/`.

- **Agents are now told to read a section, not the file it lives in.** `lat
  search` gives you a section id and its exact lines, and `lat section` prints
  just that section. An agent that opens the whole file instead can pay ten
  times the context for the same answer. The rule is added to the conventions
  block `lat init` writes into `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and the
  `lat-md-conventions` skill, so it applies on your next `lat init`.

## Upgrading

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
